text.en:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have Stealth.
Friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD units have -3" detection range.
Friendly AETHON SHAAN units have the following ability:
Unparalleled Tactician: (Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Into Darkness stratagem, that use is -1CP.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. This unit has Infiltrators.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. This model has:
Fights First.
Lone Operative.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.
PHOBOS model only. Each enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) engaged with this unit cannot be targeted by controlling player stratagems.
